change_from_v1_1: Adds KEYMASTER LEARNING GAIN JOURNAL (KLGJ), an append-only counter/journal wrapped around the full learning/search loop. KLGJ measures where boost appears, how much exact work is saved, training cost, effective search-capacity multipliers, regressions and learning slowdown/plateau. It has zero proof authority.

JUXTAPOSE.role: Preposition pivot candidates and expose exact route/order space for calibration and oracle-quality labels where exhaustive enumeration is tractable.

EXACT_JANUS.role: Sole authority for elimination fit/overflow/terminal/proof-state semantics.

M2R_PM.role: Store immutable exact pivot episodes, negative experiences, and recomputable context-conditioned movement/resource statistics.

JGPT_PIVOT_SLIME_TEACHER.role: Full-capacity NAS/CI route-ranking teacher for Pivot-Slime and Keymaster.

PIVOT_SLIME_STUDENT.role: Compact local/edge/swarm pivot scout distilled from JGPT teacher after formula-fingerprint holdout checks.

TOPA_DETECTIVE_SPIDER.role: Default composite investigator: SPIDER weaves relations; TOPA CORE attacks unsupported transfer, replay inflation, confounding and provenance defects.

KEYMASTER.role: Global pivot navigator and memory arbiter.
KEYMASTER.output: ranked pivot placement/activation plan plus structurally diverse alternates

KLGJ.role: Append-only counter/journal around the entire loop. Establish the zero baseline, record every comparable checkpoint, quantify gain/regression by subsystem and context, account for training cost, and detect slowing/plateau.
observes: JUXTAPOSE search-space size and exact baseline costs
M2R-PM episode growth and retrieval benefit
Pivot-Slime student checkpoint progression and distillation loss/regret
TOPA Detective Spider relation/falsification contributions through matched ablations
Exact JANUS checks, pair work, raw work, overflow and terminal depth
wall-clock/memory/energy diagnostics when measured on comparable hardware
core_questions: How much work did the current system save versus the frozen baseline?
Where in the pipeline did the measurable boost appear?
Which subsystem addition or checkpoint caused a gain or regression under matched ablation?
How much extra training/calibration resource was spent to obtain the downstream saving?
What is the current effective search-capacity multiplier on exact checks and pair work?
Is the learning curve still improving, slowing, plateauing or regressing?
Which unexplained gain/loss should TOPA_DETECTIVE_SPIDER investigate next?

canonical_runtime_loop: 0. KLGJ records the frozen zero/baseline configuration and accounting horizon before learning claims begin.
1. JUXTAPOSE/exact data generation exposes pivot routes and exact receipts.
2. M2R-PM stores verified episodes and retrieves structurally related history.
3. JGPT teacher learns route/resource targets from exact verified data.
4. Pivot-Slime student learns/distills compact top-k pivot navigation.
5. TOPA DETECTIVE SPIDER weaves structural relations and TOPA CORE falsifies unsupported transfer/confounding.
6. Keymaster fuses exact-memory context, JGPT/Slime proposals, Detective hypotheses and current cap into a ranked route.
7. Exact JANUS replay alone accepts/rejects the attempted pivot and determines proof-state semantics.
8. The verified receipt returns to M2R-PM/JGPT/Slime/TOPA calibration.

9. KLGJ appends the run/checkpoint, compares it only to valid matched baselines, attributes boost only through controlled ablation, subtracts training cost, updates effective-capacity and plateau/regression views.
10. KLGJ sends unexplained gain/loss and plateau signals to TOPA DETECTIVE SPIDER as investigation targets, never as truth.

klgj_accounting_contract.plateau_detector: 5 comparable holdout checkpoints by default; formula-fingerprint holdout; epsilon 0.5% median marginal improvement; plateau/regression states are diagnostic, not theorem claims.

historical_state.journal_zero_point: KLGJ begins with exact historical backfill plus a PRE_GAIN_MEASUREMENT calibration baseline; no learning speedup is claimed yet without matched holdout measurements.
